import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageGluedClass
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0FiniteStageTripleTransitionEnlargement

/-!
# A pinned class on one finite Galois glued carrier

The universal chart classes descend to a common Galois stage containing the
triple-transition coefficients. Enlarging the existing context to that stage
and gluing those classes produces a class on its literal glued carrier. The
ambient chart restrictions remain the pinned universal values.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory
open scoped TensorProduct

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {F K : Type u} [Field F] [Field K] [Algebra F K]
  [Algebra.IsAlgebraic F K] [IsGalois F K] [IsSepClosed K]
  (Ck : Over (Spec (.of K))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 Ck.hom]
  [IsProper Ck.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible Ck.hom]
  (E : Pic0FiniteStageGlueContext Ck F)
  (CM : Over (Spec (.of E.models.M.1)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 CM.hom] [IsProper CM.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible CM.hom]

local instance : IsScalarTower F E.models.M.1 K :=
  IsScalarTower.of_algebraMap_eq fun _ => rfl

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
/-- The pinned universal chart values arise from one class on the enlarged
finite-stage carrier, at a stage Galois over the original field. -/
theorem exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedClass
    (i : (baseChange E.models.M.1 K).obj CM ≅ Ck) :
    ∃ (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E.models.M.1 K)
      (h : E.triple.N.1 ≤ S.stage),
      IsGalois F S.stage ∧
      let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F :=
        ⟨E.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext h⟩
      ∃ s : pic0Subgroup ((baseChange E.models.M.1 S.stage).obj CM) P.gluedOver,
        ∀ U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex Ck,
          pic0Map CM (Over.overSpecMap
            (S.tensorMap (A := pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E.models (Sum.inl U))))
            (pic0Map CM (P.modelChartι Ck U)
              (pic0CrossBaseEquiv E.models.M.1 S.stage CM P.gluedOver s)) =
            pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass Ck E.models CM i (Sum.inl U) := by
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hG, xS, hxS, hcompat⟩ :=
    exists_pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass_compatible_isGalois Ck E.models CM i
      (DatG0.FiniteStageData.ofFinSubext E.triple.N)
  let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F := ⟨E.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext hS⟩
  obtain ⟨s, hs, _⟩ := P.existsUnique_gluedModelClass Ck CM xS hcompat
  refine ⟨S, hS, hG,
    (pic0CrossBaseEquiv E.models.M.1 S.stage CM P.gluedOver).symm s, ?_⟩
  intro U
  rw [MulEquiv.apply_symm_apply, hs U]
  exact hxS (Sum.inl U)

variable (C : Over (Spec (.of F)))
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]

set_option maxHeartbeats 800000 in
/-- Starting with a curve over the original field, the glued class belongs to
its single base change to the chosen finite Galois stage. The tower comparison
identifies its chart restrictions with the same pinned universal values. -/
theorem exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedClass_of_curve
    (i : (baseChange F K).obj C ≅ Ck) :
    ∃ (S : DatG0.FiniteStageData E.models.M.1 K)
      (h : E.triple.N.1 ≤ S.stage),
      IsGalois F S.stage ∧
      let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F :=
        ⟨E.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext h⟩
      let CM := (baseChange F E.models.M.1).obj C
      let iM := ((baseChange.compIso F E.models.M.1 K).app C).symm ≪≫ i
      ∃ s : pic0Subgroup ((baseChange F S.stage).obj C) P.gluedOver,
        ∀ U : Pic0FiniteStageChartIndex Ck,
          pic0Map CM (Over.overSpecMap
            (S.tensorMap (A := pic0FiniteStageModelAlgebra Ck E.models (Sum.inl U))))
            (pic0Map CM (P.modelChartι Ck U)
              (pic0CrossBaseEquiv E.models.M.1 S.stage CM P.gluedOver
                (pic0Pullback ((baseChange.compIso F E.models.M.1 S.stage).app C).inv
                  P.gluedOver s))) =
            pic0FiniteStageUniversalModelClass Ck E.models CM iM (Sum.inl U) := by
  let CM := (baseChange F E.models.M.1).obj C
  let iM := ((baseChange.compIso F E.models.M.1 K).app C).symm ≪≫ i
  obtain ⟨S, hS, hG, s, hs⟩ := exists_pic0FiniteStageGaloisGluedClass Ck E CM iM
  let P : Pic0FiniteStageGluePackage Ck F := ⟨E.enlarge Ck S.toFinSubext hS⟩
  refine ⟨S, hS, hG,
    pic0Pullback ((baseChange.compIso F E.models.M.1 S.stage).app C).hom P.gluedOver s,
    ?_⟩
  intro U
  rw [← pic0Pullback_comp, Iso.inv_hom_id, pic0Pullback_id]
  exact hs U

end

end AlgebraicGeometry
